x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: 1. Confirm target release, patch and end-of-support dates; read release notes and deprecations. 2. Clone production to the upgrade instance (exclusions and preserved data agreed). 3. Run evidence scripts upg.* on the clone; update the triage register. 4. Upgrade the clone (Upgrade Center / Upgrade Plan); apply store app and plugin batch updates. 5. Resolve skipped records per disposition; capture reverts/merges in remediation update sets. 6. Run ATF regression suites; log failures as upgrade defects. 7. UAT on critical journeys with process owners. 8. Upgrade dev/test; promote remediation update sets; re-run ATF. 9. Change request and production upgrade window; post-upgrade PVT (upg.verify). 10. Close out: update debt dashboard and lessons learned.
